title: Tech BSA
description:
**Required Skills**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Experience in creating Process Maps, UML Behavior Diagrams, Business – technology translation/mapping documentation**
**Proficient in JIRA or similar work management tool.**
**Experience With Scrum Process And Ceremonies.**
**Should have BFSI domain experience**
* Good knowledge on SQL and Java
* Working knowledge on REST/SOAP API
* Familiarity to application design and architecture
* Ability to write business cases and test cases
* Strong knowledge on MS office suite
* Strong troubleshooting skills
* Good understanding on Agile, waterfall methodologies
* Ability to work independently with minimal guidance


**Key Responsibilities**
* Work directly with clients to understand the business requirements
* Create process flow and reports
* Document uses cases and update SOPs'
* Perform application/functional testing
* Create functional requirements
* Work with individual users on to provide support and training
* Identify system defects

**Experience in creating Process Maps, UML Behavior Diagrams, Business – technology translation/mapping documentation**
